nodes.label: Web App Favicon (Vite lightning bolt logo)
Vite Scaffold Default Branding
nodes.rationale: The favicon is the stock purple/blue lightning-bolt icon generated by the Vite project template (Figma-exported SVG with blurred ellipse glow layers, display-p3 colors #863bff/#7e14ff/#47bfff); it indicates the web frontend has not yet replaced scaffold branding with AppYogella branding.
